resources.string: Commands run only after su grants root (uid=0). One command at a time; output is limited to 64 KB and execution to 60 seconds. Commands are stopped when you leave this page. No command history is saved.
Root access unavailable or denied; command was not executed.
Output exceeded 64 KB and was truncated.

Within this window, an active connected session waits a random 15–90 seconds before sending once that day. Leaving the app pauses the task; returning within the window schedules another random wait. The daily limit and chosen delay survive app restarts. The time window must fall within one calendar day.
The window end must be at or after its start.

Scan this app’s downloaded media, public media folders and app-specific downloads. Files are compared by size and SHA-256, not names. Temporary, encrypted, recently written and active-transfer files are skipped. The oldest identical copy is kept by default; uncheck a file to keep it and select another copy instead. Long-press a file to preview it. This only removes local copies, so cloud media may download again.
Found %1$d duplicate groups; examined %2$d files, skipped %3$d.
Partial results: scanning was cancelled or reached the 100,000-file limit.
Keep at least one copy in each group.
Delete %1$d local duplicate files (%2$s)? At least one unchanged identical copy will be retained in each group. Changed or busy files will be skipped. Review the selected paths before continuing.
Removed %1$d copies (%2$s); skipped %3$d. Rescan to refresh results.
No viewer is available for this file.

Find large files by size (100 MB minimum by default), sorted largest first. Select files individually and confirm deletion; only local copies are removed. Downloads/uploads in progress, files covered by retention rules, and recently written files are skipped.
Found %1$d large files (≥ %2$s); scanned %3$d files and skipped %4$d.
Delete the selected %1$d local large files (%2$s)? This cannot be undone; cloud messages are unaffected. Review the selection before continuing.
Deleted %1$d large files (%2$s); skipped %3$d in-use, changed, or protected files.
